[[File:Rebel_Assault_Helmet.jpg|thumb|A Rebel assault helmet]]
A '''Rebel assault helmet''' was a specifically designed combat headgear used by the personnel of the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. It was often worn by soldiers who needed to retain their agility while ensuing maximum protection against [[pulse-wave blaster]]s.
